scope: Targeted manual review of one successful extra-routed Muse NVFP4 TB2.1 round-3 trajectory; not a full clean-data certification
observations: The inspected bash calls wrote portfolio_optimized.c, portfolio_optimized.py, and temporary profiling/check scripts; they read or ran the public benchmark but did not write benchmark.py.
No inspected bash call accessed /tests, verifier or hidden paths, reward files, host mounts, or Docker socket.
This narrow check does not establish that every successful trajectory is clean.
